state NOT IN ('pending','pending_confirmed') OR pending_expires_at IS NOT NULL
state <> 'completed' OR (completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_op_id IS NOT NULL)

state NOT IN ('pending','pending_confirmed','completed') OR (receiver_id IS NOT NULL AND receiver_key_hash IS NOT NULL AND verification_reference_hash IS NOT NULL AND issue_approval_reference_hash IS NOT NULL)
state <> 'pending_confirmed' OR (pending_factor_id IS NOT NULL AND confirmation_hash IS NOT NULL)
transactional_invariants: executor binding immutable and server-derived; actor path target must still be student, authority path only designated project person independent identity; browser/other Admin cannot finalize
all write actions re-read current role/target epoch/evidence/receiver/flow under full locks; manual complete requires pending_confirmed and fresh original executor proof
flow expiry is total restricted lifetime, not extended operation authorization; original consumed/expired issue proof does not block fresh complete on current valid flow
completed/expired/abandoned terminal for that flow; reissue uses new proof/nonce, rotates flow and revokes old cap, cannot change stable executor or switch factor twice
U02 OPEN: minimization/retention configured only after separate policy approval; absent case/op after approved cleanup => unknown, never not_committed; no evidence body or classroom content
initial issue uses flow_generation=1; reissue uses current+1, atomically revokes old receiver/cap and preserves the original pending total expiry
tables.row_security: FORCE RLS; no general owner/runtime grants; fixed broker functions only; trusted executor context is server-derived, never accepted from caller SET/app parameters

tables.name: manual_recovery_operations
checks: (state = 'reserved' AND committed_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'committed' AND committed_at IS NOT NULL AND audit_id IS NOT NULL)
transactional_invariants: id is stable op_id; immutable case/executor/action/plan hash/flow prevents cross-op substitution; reservation is not operation authorization
committed fact/result_stage/audit link written in SAME transaction as corresponding case/cap/factor/epoch effect, never infer from client timeout or emit before COMMIT

status shared-locks own case/op with current executor qualifications; committed needs durable matched fact, not_committed only matched reserved op plus valid pending and proof at read linearization; missing/mismatched/minimized/inconsistent => unknown
operation rows may be minimized/deleted only under separately approved U02 policy; no secrets or signed proof body; cleanup cannot remove D0 high-water/revocation tombstones
receiver-cap abandon is a separate restricted receiver transition, not a new operator-proof command or replacement for manual complete
tables.row_security: FORCE RLS; no general owner/runtime grants; fixed broker functions only; trusted executor context is server-derived, never accepted from caller SET/app parameters

tables.name: identity_operation_proofs
checks: (executor_type = 'actor' AND executor_actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND executor_actor_user_id = executor_id AND executor_authority_id IS NULL) OR (executor_type = 'authority' AND executor_authority_id IS NOT NULL AND executor_authority_id = executor_id AND executor_actor_user_id IS NULL)
(verified_at IS NULL AND operation_deadline IS NULL) OR (verified_at IS NOT NULL AND operation_deadline > verified_at AND operation_deadline <= verified_at + interval '120 seconds')
executor_type <> 'actor' OR (actor_session_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_device_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_security_epoch IS NOT NULL)
executor_type <> 'authority' OR authority_version IS NOT NULL
verified_at IS NULL OR verified_at < challenge_expires_at
action <> 'complete' OR (pending_factor_id IS NOT NULL AND confirmation_hash IS NOT NULL)
transactional_invariants: challenge expiry only controls completing all verification; server DB actual verified_at recorded after factors/signature/scope success, never client/challenge issuance time

deadline min(verified_at+120 seconds,current qualifying credentials,existing pending expiry); all locks acquired then clock_timestamp < deadline and fresh current qualifications rechecked; equality rejects
each issue/reissue and complete uses a different proof/action/nonce; completion_nonce consumed exactly once with cap and final effects; issue nonce remains consumed and is not consumed twice
write proof embeds exact deployment/case/op/executor/target role+epoch/plan/receiver/flow and complete factor+confirmation; any change invalidates it
status proofs are ephemeral independent read credentials, NOT rows here; status cannot insert/update/consume this table
challenge creation/verification/consumption transactions enumerate all parent FK locks in global order, commit before interactive waits; no proof lock held while later acquiring users
tables.row_security: FORCE RLS; no general owner/runtime grants; fixed broker functions only; trusted executor context is server-derived, never accepted from caller SET/app parameters

tables.name: manual_recovery_capabilities
transactional_invariants: digest only; scope solely receiver proof-of-new-factor or explicit abandon, no final/status/ordinary session/WS ticket/cache/content/codes authority
validity requires current matching target epoch/case flow/receiver and unexpired pending; issue/reissue atomically invalidates older cap before next flow
manual complete consumes cap plus NEW completion proof; original issue proof fact checked for provenance/not revoked but never reconsumed
cap response loss never replays plaintext; independent authorized status then separately fresh issue/reissue as case permits
tables.row_security: FORCE RLS; no general owner/runtime grants; fixed broker functions only; trusted executor context is server-derived, never accepted from caller SET/app parameters

tables.name: identity_revocation_notices
checks: (kind = 'authority_revoked' AND authority_id IS NOT NULL AND authority_version IS NOT NULL) OR (kind <> 'authority_revoked' AND subject_user_id IS NOT NULL AND security_epoch IS NOT NULL)
transactional_invariants: independent internal identity notice, never business owner_event_counter/outbox/task FK or public WS event; minimal nonsecret payload only
producer holds all referenced users and control parents in ordered transaction before INSERT; audit/notice atomic with security change
claim transaction locks only notice rows, writes bounded lease and commits/releases BEFORE separately reading current user/authority or closing connections
ack/retry/cleanup transactions touch only notice rows; no event-held user/counter lookup; bounded lease cleanup deletes exact rows and grants no restored authorization
delivery is advisory and at-least-once; dropped/duplicate notice cannot authorize, finalize or resend Provider; realtime PG authorization remains source of truth
unique notice source key uses NULLS NOT DISTINCT for nullable subject; authority-only maintenance notices do not invent a Web user or acquire a late target user FK
authority-only notices carry authority_version rather than fabricating target Web security_epoch; user notices carry actual users.security_epoch
tables.row_security: FORCE RLS; no general owner/runtime grants; fixed broker functions only; trusted executor context is server-derived, never accepted from caller SET/app parameters

tables.name: identity_control_audit
transactional_invariants: append-only minimized nonsecret control audit; executor and references server-derived; bounded action/result enum follows identity-control schema; no signed package body, evidence detail, key/seed/token or classroom content
written in the same successful operation/maintenance transaction; failure rolls back business changes; minimal references intentionally do not add late user/case FK locks
U02 OPEN: real retention/access/deletion rules not frozen; status op facts and anti-rollback D0 control tombstones have separate lifecycles
tables.row_security: FORCE RLS; fixed broker append/status projection functions only; no generic runtime/scheduler/admin read or mutation

tables.name: recovery_receivers
checks: mode IS NULL OR mode IN ('manual','auto_code')
mode <> 'manual' OR (bound_case_id IS NOT NULL AND bound_auto_challenge_id IS NULL)
mode <> 'auto_code' OR (bound_auto_challenge_id IS NOT NULL AND bound_case_id IS NULL)
mode IS NOT NULL OR (bound_case_id IS NULL AND bound_auto_challenge_id IS NULL AND flow_generation IS NULL)
mode IS NULL OR (flow_generation IS NOT NULL AND registration_consumed_at IS NOT NULL)

jsonb_typeof(public_key) = 'object' AND public_key ?& ARRAY['kty','crv','x','y'] AND (public_key - ARRAY['kty','crv','x','y']) = '{}'::jsonb AND public_key->>'kty' = 'EC' AND public_key->>'crv' = 'P-256'
transactional_invariants: registration stores only public EC P-256 JWK (kty/crv/x/y, no private d) and RFC7638 SHA256 thumbprint; registration itself grants no case, recovery, ordinary session or final authority

each receiver action signs server current single-use nonce + case/auto challenge + flow + receiver_id + canonical request hash; under ordered locks consume old nonce and replace digest/request_generation, reject replay
unbound registration expires independently; after binding all nonce/action expiry is capped by original pending flow expiry; nonce rotation never renews that total flow
case/op locked before receiver when binding or performing an action; insert/update FK references only prelocked case/challenge parents; no receiver lock held while acquiring users/case

issue binds initial flow 1; reissue uses current+1 and revokes old cap/receiver channel atomically without extending original total pending expiry; complete still requires original operator fresh proof
tables.row_security: FORCE RLS; bounded anonymous register and receiver-PoP fixed functions only; no general owner/runtime grant; server establishes deployment and binding, case_id knowledge is not authority

identity_contract_scope.logical_control_schema: identity_control; new logical subset only; existing public tables are not relocated
identity_contract_scope.implementation_gate: S2 independent approval and separately authorized S3 scope required; do not create all architecture tables

identity_contract_scope.status_storage: Business-read-only status uses ephemeral independently authenticated proof; it creates/consumes no recovery proof, nonce, cap or case row
